name: Plantar Fasciopathy Rehabilitation Protocol
description: Evidence-based 12-week protocol for plantar fasciopathy based on the Rathleff High-Load Strength Training
pain_rule: Pain max. 3/10 during the exercise. Morning stiffness under 10 minutes as a goal.
evidence_base: Rathleff et al. (2015): High-load strength training superior to stretching for plantar fasciopathy
Riel et al. (2019): Isometric exercise for plantar fasciopathy pain relief
Martin et al. (2014): Heel pain clinical practice guidelines (JOSPT)
Whittaker et al. (2019): Progressive loading for plantar heel pain
progression_criteria: Single-leg heel raise with bodyweight without pain

exercises.name: Isometric Calf Raise
exercises.description: Standing on a step, balls of feet on the edge. Hold position with slightly raised heel
exercises.phase_goal: Pain reduction and initiate plantar fascia loading

exercises.name: Isometric Towel Scrunch
exercises.description: Seated, foot on towel. Curl toes and grip towel. Hold position
exercises.phase_goal: Pain reduction and initiate plantar fascia loading

exercises.name: Heel Raise with Towel Roll
exercises.description: Standing on a step, rolled towel under toes. Slowly rise onto toes and back down (Rathleff protocol)
exercises.phase_goal: Increase plantar fascia load capacity (Rathleff protocol)

exercises.name: Single-Leg Heel Raise
exercises.description: Standing on one leg on a step, rolled towel under toes. Slowly rise and lower
exercises.phase_goal: Increase plantar fascia load capacity (Rathleff protocol)

exercises.name: Toe Yoga
exercises.description: Seated, raise big toe while keeping small toes on the ground, then reverse. Strengthen foot muscles
exercises.phase_goal: Increase plantar fascia load capacity (Rathleff protocol)

exercises.name: Heavy Heel Raise
exercises.description: Single-leg heel raise with added weight (backpack or dumbbells). Towel roll under toes
exercises.phase_goal: Return to full weight-bearing and activity

exercises.name: Light Jump Rope
exercises.description: Light, controlled jump rope on soft surface. Only if pain-free
exercises.phase_goal: Return to full weight-bearing and activity
